name: codex-stream-recovery
description: Recover interrupted Codex turns by rebuilding continuation context from Codex session files.

interface.shortDescription: Resume work after Codex stream disconnects.
interface.longDescription: Codex Stream Recovery rebuilds a continuation package from local Codex session JSONL files after reconnect exhaustion or stream-disconnected failures. It creates a recovery JSON file and a ready-to-send recovery prompt so work can continue in a new Codex turn without depending on any target repository.
interface.defaultPrompt: Recover the latest interrupted Codex turn and generate a continuation prompt.
